gold_doubt: The gold excludes the minister's reported count of more than 70 active rigs. It is a named, numerical claim about drilling activity that could inform a judgment about oil supply under 5.1, although its period and incremental significance are unclear.

The gold excludes the report that there were no major pipeline outages during the review period. That is a specific operational condition that could matter to supply reliability under 5.1, even though the surrounding explanation is general.
